name: chart
title: Chart
description: Single-stack echarts charting: a tree-shaken echarts registry, a thin React adapter (EChart), a structured-data component (DataChart for line/bar/pie/doughnut), and the shared color palette as the single color source. China/USA GeoJSON ships with the item under maps/ for echarts.registerMap via dynamic import.
postInstall: Render <DataChart chartType="line|bar|pie|doughnut" labels={...} datasets={[{ label, data }]} /> for structured data, or <EChart option={...} /> for raw echarts options; both size to their parent via className/style. Colors come from CHART_PALETTE (single source) — pass no per-dataset colors unless overriding deliberately. For maps, dynamically import the bundled GeoJSON (e.g. await import('@/components/chart/maps/china.json')) and call echarts.registerMap('china', geoJson) once before using series type 'map'.
